name: PSQ-Full Sub-Agent
description: Psychoemotional Safety Quotient (PSQ-Full) scorer. Scores English text on 10 orthogonal psychological safety dimensions using a DistilBERT student model via ONNX inference.

extensions.description: Per-claim confidence, SETL, epistemic flags, action gate, correction mechanism.

context_aware_scoring.note: Optional. When specified, response includes context_weighted_composite (0-10 weighted mean) and context_weights_used. Schema bumps to v3.1 (additive, backward-compatible with v3 consumers).

scoring.composite_status: usable (psq_composite: 0-100 weighted protective/threat formula; context_weighted_composite: 0-10 per-context weighted mean when context specified)

known_limitations.description: Per-dimension confidence values are static held-out Pearson r estimates, not per-prediction reliability signals. The model confidence head is anti-calibrated and discarded at inference time. Confidence = r-based reliability prior, constant per dimension across all inputs.
known_limitations.mitigation: Do not interpret confidence as varying by input text. Use confidence as a dimension-level reliability weight (higher r = more validated dimension). See calibration_note in each dimension's response field for the specific r value.

known_limitations.description: Trained on WEIRD population data only. Culturally situated dimensions (authority_dynamics, contractual_obligation) have higher uncertainty for non-WEIRD text.
No human expert validation yet. AI-only scoring ground truth. Protocol designed but not executed.

DA (defensive_architecture) has weakest factor loading (0.332) but is paradoxically the strongest criterion predictor. CO (contractual_obligation) is the weakest overall predictor (held-out r = 0.504).

scope_boundary: Validated for: English social media stress text, self-report format. Not validated for: clinical intake notes, therapist-authored text, non-English, non-WEIRD populations, texts > 128 tokens.
tier_note: PSQ-Full (10-dim, DistilBERT, validated) vs PSQ-Lite (3-dim, LLM heuristic, observatory-agent). Namespace resolution agreed in transport/sessions/item2-derivation/psq-lite-response-001.json.
